paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of Llama3 under different question popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
This line chart illustrates how three performance metrics—Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment—of the Llama3-8B model vary as a function of Question Popularity, ranging from 15 to 55. The vertical axis, labeled "Values," is scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 0.2. The horizontal axis, labeled "Question Popularity," is also linearly scaled, spanning from 15 to 55, with labeled tick marks at every 5-unit interval. The chart contains three distinct lines, each corresponding to a different metric as indicated in the legend.

The blue line, representing Accuracy, is marked with circular points and is drawn as a solid line. It begins at approximately 0.53 when Question Popularity is 15 and rises steadily to approximately 0.96 at Question Popularity 55. The green line, representing Confidence, is marked with triangular points and is also a solid line. It starts at approximately 0.84 at Question Popularity 15 and increases slightly to approximately 0.98 at Question Popularity 55. The red line, representing Alignment, is marked with square points and is a solid line. It begins at approximately 0.68 at Question Popularity 15 and increases gradually to approximately 0.98 at Question Popularity 55. All three lines show a general upward trend across the range of Question Popularity values shown.
model_annotations.German: This line chart, titled "Llama3-8B on Movies," illustrates the QA performance metrics—Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment—for the Llama3-8B model across varying levels of question popularity. The x-axis, labeled "Question Popularity," spans from 15 to 55 with a linear scale and tick marks at regular intervals of 5, representing the popularity of movie-related questions. The y-axis, labeled "Values," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale, indicating normalized performance scores. The blue line with circular markers represents Accuracy, starting at approximately 0.54 at question popularity 15 and rising to about 0.96 at 55. The green line with triangular markers represents Confidence, beginning at approximately 0.84 at 15 and increasing slightly to about 0.98 at 55. The red line with square markers represents Alignment, starting at approximately 0.69 at 15 and increasing to approximately 0.99 at 55. All three lines show a general upward trend as question popularity increases, with Confidence consistently remaining above Accuracy and Alignment.
